about: Partii examples: short working examples, each with a test, a README and a TRAPS.md. Search by tags and when; copy the folder; run its test. Web examples: cd <path> && npm install && npm test (Partii staging, headless).

sdk.web: Partii's TypeScript SDK, installed by each example's get-sdk.mjs from https://partii.games/docs/sdk-ts/ (client.ts, generated.ts, buy.ts) and imported as @partii/sdk and @partii/sdk/buy. No npm package yet.

staging.note: A publishable key (public by design) for the shared test game. Use your own game's key for your game.

examples.title: Starter shell: Vite + TypeScript web game on Partii
examples.when: Starting any new web game on Partii: guest player, analytics, error reports, staging and production builds.
examples.test: cd examples/01-starter-shell && npm install && npm test

examples.title: Sign in: guest to account, sign out, sign back in
examples.when: Letting a guest keep their progress with an email account, or adding sign-out.
examples.test: cd examples/02-sign-in && npm install && npm test

examples.title: Cloud save and load with conflict merge
examples.when: Keeping a player's progress or settings across devices.
examples.test: cd examples/03-save-load && npm install && npm test

examples.title: Leaderboard: submit once per run, rank and top 10
examples.when: Showing a score, distance or time board with the player's own rank.
examples.test: cd examples/04-leaderboard && npm install && npm test

examples.title: Buy an item with Pops and unlock it
examples.when: Selling a skin, level, full-game unlock or consumable for Pops.
examples.test: cd examples/05-buy-unlock && npm install && npm test

examples.title: Analytics: batched events, sessions and the drop rules
examples.when: Tracking gameplay events and sessions without Partii silently dropping them.
examples.test: cd examples/06-analytics && npm install && npm test

examples.title: Godot 4 add-on: player, saves, buys, leaderboards, tilt, analytics
examples.when: A Godot 4 game exported to the web that needs Partii (copy of PartiiGames/partii-godot, the source of truth).
examples.test: cd examples/13-godot-addon && godot --headless --path . --export-release Web build/web/index.html && node tests/web/motion.mjs build/web && node tests/web/frame-motion.mjs build/web && PARTII_GAME=partii-examples PARTII_KEY=pk_examples_examples_Iejc-8371u7-wd8nn-BJzY PARTII_API=https://api-staging.partii.games node tests/web/staging.mjs build/web

examples.title: hlab humanoid: WASD idle, walk and run on three.js
examples.when: Putting a generated human character in a three.js web game and moving it with the keyboard, feet matched to the clips.
examples.test: cd examples/15-hlab && npm install && npm test
